description: Wariyapola Pradeshiya Sabha - The List of the Roads and Throughfares the Wariyapola Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily deals with land and property matters, specifically the declaration and listing of roads and thoroughfares owned by the Pradeshiya Sabha Wariyapola local government authority. It includes detailed schedules of road coordinates, lengths, and widths, and addresses legal procedures for land claims related to these roads. The content focuses on land ownership, property boundaries, and land registration rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
